phrases.text: A dataset or report breaking down issues by reporting company, specifically counting issues whose resolution status indicates no fix was required, and identifying which company has the highest such count within a named system/product.
Find the name of company that reported the maximum number of issues that didn’t need fixes in ForecastForce?
A changelog or release-notes style entry listing newly added features in a product that enable or enhance integration with third-party Slack applications.
What new features related to integration with third-party Slack apps are added to ActionGenie?

A document record (such as a market research report's metadata or cover/credits section) that identifies the specific employee IDs of the people who authored the report and those who served as its key reviewers, for a particular product.
Find employee IDs of the authors and key reviewers of the Market Research Report for the ActionGenie product?

A set of links or references to version-control pull requests associated with building frontend UI components for a real-time insights feature, filtered to show only those whose review status is not approved (e.g., rejected, pending, or changes requested).
Can you find links to PRs for developing frontend components for real-time insights in CoachForce that were not approved?
A list or compilation of web links (URLs) shared internally by team members, pointing to demonstration pages or product demos of companies competing with VizForce.
Find the demo URLs shared by team members for VizForce's competitor products?
A data record or report listing companies along with their counts of unresolved bugs within a system named MonitorForce, from which the company with the highest such count can be identified.
Find the name of company that has the maximum number of unresolved bugs in MonitorForce?

A description or list of newly introduced features in a software product's release notes or changelog, specifically detailing functionality related to AI model updates and resource allocation management.
What new features about AI model updates resource allocation are added to ActionGenie?

A document record (such as a document control or metadata page) that lists the people who authored and reviewed a specific product vision document, including identifying information such as their employee ID numbers.
Find employee IDs of the authors and key reviewers of the Product Vision Document for the ActionGenie product?

A list or collection of links/references pointing to pull requests connected to a disaster recovery strategy, filtered to show only those PRs that did not receive approval (e.g., rejected, declined, or left unapproved).
Can you find links to PRs related to the disaster recovery strategy in CoachForce that were not approved?

A list or identification of specific companies that were impacted by a technical malfunction in a product's backend machine learning recommendation model, where the malfunction caused recommendations to be misaligned and resulted in decreased user engagement.
Find the names of companies were affected by issues in the backend machine learning model of PersonalizeForce that led to misaligned recommendations and reduced user engagement?
